title: Choosing a rail itinerary
passage:
DOCUMENT 1 — EASTLINE RAIL: TUESDAY SERVICES
Northbridge to Port Haven, direct trains
Service E12: departs 07:10; arrives 09:05; standard fare $46; flexible fare $64.
Service E18: departs 08:20; arrives 10:00; standard fare $52; flexible fare $70.
Service E24: departs 09:15; arrives 11:10; standard fare $46; flexible fare $64.
Standard tickets are valid only on the booked train and cannot be refunded. Flexible tickets can be changed once, without an administration fee, before departure; any fare difference remains payable. A taxi from Port Haven station to the Maritime Centre normally takes 25 minutes. The public bus takes approximately 50 minutes.

DOCUMENT 2 — EMAIL
From: Rowan Lee, Maritime Centre
To: Dana Holt
Subject: Tuesday panel
Thank you for agreeing to speak at our panel on Tuesday. Please arrive by 10:30 a.m. for a microphone check; the audience enters at eleven. We will reimburse your rail fare up to $75 and your taxi from the station. Please retain receipts. Your panel ends at 1 p.m., and lunch is available afterward. If your travel plans change, contact me rather than the venue's general reception.

DOCUMENT 3 — MESSAGE
Dana to assistant, Monday 4:15 p.m.
Please book tomorrow's train. I can't leave Northbridge before eight because I must drop off some documents. Choose a service that gets me to the microphone check on time, allowing for the taxi ride. My morning appointment might run late, so I need a ticket that lets me change trains if necessary. Keep the rail fare within Rowan's reimbursement limit. I'll arrange my return journey after the panel.

文件一：Eastline 鐵路星期二班次
Northbridge 直達 Port Haven。
E12：07:10 出發，09:05 抵達；標準票$46，彈性票$64。
E18：08:20 出發，10:00 抵達；標準票$52，彈性票$70。
E24：09:15 出發，11:10 抵達；標準票$46，彈性票$64。
標準票只限預訂班次，不退款。彈性票在發車前可改一次，免行政費，若有差額仍須補繳。車站搭計程車到 Maritime Centre 通常二十五分鐘，公車約五十分鐘。

文件二：郵件
Maritime Centre 的 Rowan Lee 寄給 Dana Holt，主旨：星期二座談。
感謝同意擔任座談講者。請最遲於上午十點半抵達，以便測試麥克風，觀眾十一點入場。火車票最高可報銷 $75，車站到會場的計程車費也可報銷，請保留收據。座談下午一點結束，之後有午餐。如行程改變，請聯絡我，不要聯絡場地一般櫃檯。

文件三：訊息
Dana 星期一下午四點十五分傳給助理。
請訂明天火車。我得先送文件，最早要到上午八點才能離開 Northbridge。選能準時到麥克風測試的班次，並算入計程車車程。早上的安排可能會耽擱，所以需要可改班次的票。票價不要超過 Rowan 說的報銷上限，回程我會在座談後安排。
